200.description: The scan was refused with findings; nothing was booked.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the resource: the quoted `version`, for example `"3"`.

kind.description: What a scan resolves to. `qty` counts cases for `CASE_GTIN` and eaches for `EACH_GTIN`.
kind.title: ScanKind

lines.description: The receipt's lines after the scan.

lpn.description: The SSCC, or an internal `LPN-<ulid>` for a carton received without one.

kind.description:
`HOMOGENEOUS_CASE` = one SKU in a case pack; `MIXED` = several SKUs, a
logistic unit only (no pack GTIN).
kind.title: CartonKind

gtin.description: GTIN of the content, 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid GS1 check digit; returned zero-padded to 14.

condition.description: Whether received units are fit to stock. Only `Good` is handed to inventory-storage.
condition.title: Condition

kind.description:
Raised on `CartonDiscrepancyRaised`, never on `ReceiptClosed`.
`UnexpectedCarton` = an SSCC not on the manifest; `MissingCarton` = a
manifest carton never accepted (raised at close); `DuplicateSscc` =
scanned twice or already received; `UnknownGtin` = a GTIN the
PackagingView does not know; `CaseQtyMismatch` = quantity differs from
the active CASE units per pack or the label count;
`MixedCaseDeclaredAsCasePack` = the label's content contradicts the
manifest SKU; `UnlabelledCarton` = a case with no SSCC against a carton
ASN.
kind.title: CartonDiscrepancyKind

400.description:
Malformed JSON or an unknown field (`malformed-request`), a bad query
parameter (`invalid-query`), a missing `Idempotency-Key`
(`idempotency-key-required`), or a value that breaks a domain rule
(the `invalid-*`, `*-requires-*`, `duplicate-*`, `window-in-past` and
`invalid-condition`, `invalid-carton*`, `invalid-scan*`, `invalid-cases`,
`invalid-gtin`, `invalid-sscc` and `invalid-owner-ref` slugs).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: resource-creating requests must send a non-empty Idempotency-Key

value.title: SKU is invalid
value.detail: sku must be 1..64 characters without whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: Window is invalid
value.detail: window must end after it starts and last at most 4 hours

404.description:
The resource in the path does not exist: `asn-not-found`,
`appointment-not-found` or `receipt-not-found`.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

409.description:
The request conflicts with current state: `asn-already-exists`,
`asn-in-progress`, `asn-terminal`, `asn-not-receivable`,
`appointment-not-booked`, `appointment-not-checked-in`,
`outside-check-in-window`, `door-window-overlap`,
`receipt-already-open`, `receipt-closed`, or a write that lost a race
(`concurrent-modification`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: ASN already exists
value.detail: an asn with this number is already registered

asnInProgress.summary: Cancelling an ASN that is being received

value.title: ASN is being received
value.detail: asn is being received and cannot be cancelled

doorWindowOverlap.summary: Door already booked in an overlapping window

value.title: Door is already booked in an overlapping window
value.detail: door is already booked in an overlapping window

outsideCheckInWindow.summary: Checking in too early or too late

value.title: Check-in is outside the allowed window
value.detail: check-in is only allowed from 30 minutes before the window until it ends

receiptAlreadyOpen.summary: The ASN already has an open receipt

value.title: ASN already has an open receipt
value.detail: only one receipt may be open per asn

value.title: The resource was modified by another request; re-fetch the latest version and retry

412.description: The `If-Match` value does not match the resource's current version; re-fetch and retry.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

example.title: The If-Match version is stale
example.detail: if-match does not match the current version

422.description:
The request is well-formed but refers to something that does not hold:
`unknown-sku` (`PRODUCT_MODE=kafka` only), `unknown-dock-door`
(`DOCK_DOOR_MODE=kafka` only), `unknown-asn`, `unknown-appointment`,
`asn-not-on-appointment`, `line-not-on-asn`, `invalid-sscc`,
`duplicate-sscc`, `homogeneous-carton-mixed`, `carton-contents-mismatch`,
`scan-kind-mismatch`, `unsupported-pack-level`, or an `Idempotency-Key`
reused with a different body (`idempotency-key-reused`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.detail: sku SKU-TYPO is not known to product-master

value.title: Door is not a known inbound dock door
